fields.description:
Partner core identity field set, with Partner Type relocated into a new Partner Details section.

=== FIELDS ===

* Partner Name — Name

* Partner Type — Picklist, single value to start: Affiliate Network. Joyce: 'we'll start with just the affiliate network.' Deferred candidates: SaaS business, influencer/publisher.

* Status — Picklist: Active; Inactive — automation is BUILD-147

* Website — URL

* Parent Company — Text, free text, no lookup

* Primary Contact — Lookup(Contact), lands in Partner Details per Joyce

* Billing Contact — Lookup(Contact), lands in the Billing block

* Primary Contact Email / Phone — cross-object relationship fields off Primary Contact, read-only

* Partner Portal — URL

* Operational Notes — Long Text Area. Joyce: 'there's a lot of nuances when we work with partners, so you want to give them space to leave notes.'

* Logo — see BUILD-145

=== IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS ===

* Create a Partner Details section and put Partner Type in it. Kobi: 'I think partner type, I would actually put it under a partner details section.' Joyce: 'It makes more sense, right? It's an attribute of the partner.'

* Secondary Contact is CUT — same decision as Operator. Taryn's PT-1 story lists it at bullet 11; that bullet came from the stale PRD. Also verify 'Target Tier', which was named in the same breath on the Aug 17 call and never discussed — it may be equally stale.

* No Partner Owner custom field — Joyce confirmed removal on both objects (Slack Aug 14 15:10: 'Yeah'). Standard OwnerId only.

* No 'Active Status' duplicate — Joyce: 'my active status is down there. So I would remove that.'

* No Asset Library field.

* Partner has no equivalent to Operator's Management Details section — confirmed asymmetry, not a gap.

* Do NOT add a 'Direct' value to Partner Type. Decided 2026-08-17: 'let's leave this one out for now unless we have a requirement that comes up for this.' Direct is modelled as a Partner RECORD named Direct, not a type value — consistent with Joyce on Aug 13: 'it's not a type, it's not a value on the direct page.' Taryn's PT-1 story lists Direct as a picklist value; ignore it.

* Do not mark any field required on the page layout. No validation rules are being built yet — decided 2026-08-17.

=== OPEN QUESTIONS ===

* Marc's related thread: is 'Direct' one shared Partner account or one per operator? Currently a single shared account pending client confirmation (Slack Aug 13 23:37).

=== NOTES ===

* PARTIALLY BUILT. The Partner Lightning page was converted to Dynamic Forms on the morning of Aug 17 — Taryn: 'I did that to partner this morning because I noticed it wasn't dynamic. Operator was already dynamic.' The fields themselves are still outstanding: 'I still have some partner fields that I need to create and then add into the page layout.'

* Provenance: PT-1.

=== SOURCE ===

* Taryn doc PT-1

* Aug 13 call

* Slack Joyce Aug 14 15:10

* Aug 17 call — page converted, fields outstanding, Secondary Contact cut

Dependencies: None — foundational

Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer

Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.

Created 2026-08-17 from the Operator/Partner ticket review, approved by Kobi.

comments.body: Partially built, per this ticket's own notes: Spec calls for Partner Name, Partner Type (picklist: Affiliate Network, in a new Partner Details section), Status (Active/Inactive), Website, Parent Company, Primary/Billing Contact lookups, Primary Contact Email/Phone as relationship fields, Partner Portal, Operational Notes, and Logo.
